findings.current: Around two hundred Hunters from the Ares Guild and Peace Guild had come with us.
findings.defect: “Around two hundred” makes the count approximate in both directions, while 이백여 명 means more than two hundred. The accepted baseline preserves that quantity.
findings.rationale: The source specifies a count exceeding two hundred; the assembled English can include fewer than two hundred.
findings.replacement: More than two hundred Hunters from the Ares Guild and Peace Guild had come with us.

summary: Two minor fidelity defects: the Hunter count loses the source’s over-200 quantity, and the incoming attack is described twice.
